children.design_delta_summary: Tightens the kernel port contract with three bounded moves: (1) replace the coarse supported-pCID list with per-pCID capability entries naming the local promiser plus receive/send/proof/byte-retention behavior, (2) add a deterministic DAG-CBOR local outcome ledger that distinguishes kept, refused, unavailable, broken, unsupported-pCID, unverifiable-proof, and timeout observations with exact-byte or CID witnesses, and (3) import protocol-owned proof auditing from the envelope parent only as an optional per-pCID capability declaration, not as a universal mandatory outer signature slot.
